meta.note: 14-period RSI on 1-minute SPY/QQQ closes (9-period for RSI Reversal 9), warmed up with the prior afternoon (overnight gap removed). Targets and stops are the same size (1:1), so random entries win about half the time; compare every group with Random control. New trades 9:35 AM–1:00 PM, bought at the next minute's open; one trade at a time, max 5 per model per day. Target and stop live until 3:30 PM, then anything still open is sold. 3x ETFs, $100 per trade, $0.005 per share each way. MU has no 3x ETF, so MU trades are a 3x estimate from Micron's own move, 0.03% round-trip cost

groups.name: RSI Momentum
groups.desc: Crosses up through 60 → bull ETF · down through 40 → bear ETF · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI Long only
groups.desc: Only the buys: back above 30 → bull ETF · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI Short only
groups.desc: Only the sells: back below 70 → bear ETF · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI Clean reversal
groups.desc: Trades the 3rd extreme of a clean alternating run (bottom, top, bottom or top, bottom, top) · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI 3 hits (75+)
groups.desc: Trades the 3rd top-out (or bottom-out) in a row; hits 2 and 3 must reach 75+ (25 or lower for bottoms)

groups.name: RSI 4 hits (75+)
groups.desc: Trades the 4th top-out (or bottom-out) in a row; hits 2–4 must reach 75+ (25 or lower for bottoms)

groups.name: RSI 5 hits
groups.desc: Trades the 5th top-out (or bottom-out) in a row at the normal 70 / 30 levels

groups.name: RSI 6 hits
groups.desc: Trades the 6th top-out (or bottom-out) in a row at the normal 70 / 30 levels

groups.name: RSI Reversal 9
groups.desc: 9-period RSI · back above 30 → bull ETF · back below 70 → bear ETF · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI 20, 2 bounces
groups.desc: 20-period RSI · trades the 2nd bottom-out (or top-out) in a row at 70 / 30 · new trades 9:35–1:00, max 5 a day

groups.name: RSI Into extreme
groups.desc: Buys as RSI first drops below 30 → bull ETF · first rises above 70 → bear ETF · no waiting for the rebound

groups.name: Random control
groups.desc: Random entry times and a coin flip for direction · same tiers and exits · the yardstick to beat
